rationale: Substantival noun on root ⲟⲩⲣⲟ/ⲣ̄ⲣⲟ 'king,' here designating the eschatological royal reward of the traveler-for-God in parallel with 'crown and palm-branch' of line 16. Distinct from verbal ⲣ̄-ⲡⲟ 'reign' (already in glossary).
Lyc. form likely from ⲧⲁⲕⲟ 'destroy.' Paired antithetically with ⲡⲛⲁⲃⲉ 'Sin' in 'the road of Sin and Destruction' (line 24) — capitalized as cosmic principle.
Verb in line 15 governing ⲛⲛⲟⲁⲡ ⲛ̄ⲣⲉⲧϥ̄ 'soles of his foot' upon the cross of Light. Possibly reduplicated form of a treading-verb. Confidence low.
In construction ⲛⲛⲟⲁⲡ ⲛ̄ⲣⲉⲧϥ̄ 'the X of his foot' — anatomically must be soles/treading-surface. Possibly Lyc. plural of an under-part term. Confidence low.

Compound: ⲡ- (article) + ⲣ̄- (verbal prefix) + ϩⲁⲧⲉ ('front, before'). Substantivized 'the going-before, the prior thing' — anaphoric reference to a previously-treated topic. Confirms tentative accumulated entry ⲡⲱⲣⲡ̄ϩⲁⲧⲉ as variant of same compound.
